title: The Riemann Hypothesis through the looking of partitions
summary: An equivalence of the Riemann Hypothesis due to Espinosa reveals a direct bridge to the theory of integer partitions. Building on this formulation, we analyze the asymptotic behavior of a family of combinatorial sums $A_r(n)$, called Espinosa's branches, and their realization by divisors of superabundant numbers. Our main result is an unconditional asymptotic formula for the associated cutoff divisors: for every fixed integer $r\geq 1$, $d^{(r)}(N)\sim e^{-γ}(\log N)^{α_r}$, as $N$ tends to infinity through superabundant numbers, where the exponents $α_r$ are given by the Dickman--de Bruijn…
